_comment: Maid Watcher config (Maid BT component). Up to 2 BT audio devices in priority order (Classic multipoint caps at 2 links; forks welcome to do more).

case_detect._case_detect: Docked-in-charging-case recognition. probe_s = one passive BlueZ discovery window in seconds (advertising = out of case; radio-silent the whole window = docked). recheck_s = lid-open recheck cadence while docked. The buds normally self-connect on case-open; the recheck is the backstop for when they join the phone first.
